PotteryMania

PotteryMania is pottery studio software for ceramic artists, potters, teachers, and studios.
It helps creators sell handmade ceramics online, accept class bookings, publish studio pages, and grow revenue from one platform.

Best for:
- solo ceramic artists
- pottery studios
- teachers running workshops or recurring classes
- makers who want an online storefront and booking system

Core public areas:
- Home: /
- Pricing: /pricing
- Marketplace: /marketplace
- Classes: /classes
- Studios: /studios
- Wear shop: /wear/shop

Core features:
- product storefronts for handmade ceramics
- pottery class and workshop booking pages
- public studio profile pages
- wearable merchandise storefronts
- studio news and content publishing
- marketplace discovery across studios

Pricing summary:
- PotteryMania offers studio plans with monthly pricing shown at /pricing
- pricing and commission information should be treated as dynamic and sourced from the live pricing page

How to get started:
- visit /pricing to compare plans
- visit /register to create an account
- create a studio, add products or classes, and publish public pages

Canonical website:
- https://potterymania.com
